facts.title: Dill Pickle Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces (2 cups) sour cream or plain Greek yogurt
2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, plus more for garnish
2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives, plus more for garnish
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Serving suggestions: Wavy potato chips, and sticks of carrot, celery or bell pepper
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a small serving bowl, combine the sour cream, chopped pickles, brine, dill and chives. Stir to combine, then season with a few twists of black pepper, to taste.
Sprinkle the top lightly with chopped chives, dill and another twist of pepper. Serve as desired. Leftover pickle dip will keep well in the refrigerator, covered, for up to 4 days.

notes: Make it dairy free/vegan: Substitute my vegan sour cream. Double the recipe to yield 2 cups.
facts.summary: This dill pickle dip recipe is creamy, rich and full of fresh flavor! It’s a relatively healthy homemade dip that’s ready in 10 minutes. This dip is perfect for game day watch parties or a fun snack. Recipe yields about 3 ½ cups dip, enough for 7 to 10 servings.
